'''Bumpy's Breakers''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] track on the planet of [[Aquilaris]]. This course was the seventh and final race in the [[Semipro Podracing Circuit]]. [[Ark Roose/Legends|Ark Roose]] preferred this course.

==Other tracks of Aquilaris==
*[[Amateur Podracing Circuit|Amateur Circuit]] track: [[Aquilaris Classic/Legends|Aquilaris Classic]]
*Other [[Semipro Podracing Circuit|Semipro Circuit]] track: [[Sunken City/Legends|Sunken City]]
